subject: general
question: Which idiom best describes the importance of consuming essential metals in the right amounts, as highlighted in the passage?

options.text: A stitch in time saves nine
Too much of a good thing
Every cloud has a silver lining

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option (3)** i.e. Too much of a good thing.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"Too much of a good thing"** means that something beneficial can become harmful if taken or consumed in excess. This idiom highlights the importance of moderation, especially in the context of consuming essential metals in the right amounts. (अच्छी चीज़ की अधिकता का नुकसान)

 
 
• **Example: **While vitamins are essential for health, too much of a good thing can lead to toxicity.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Too much of a good thing**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained:

 
• **A bitter pill to swallow** (कड़वा घूंट पीना):

 
 
• This idiom refers to an unpleasant fact or situation that is difficult to accept.
 
• **Example: **Receiving criticism was a bitter pill to swallow.
 
 
 
• **A stitch in time saves nine** (समय पर किया गया कार्य बाद में बड़ा नुकसान बचा सकता है):
 
 
• This idiom means that taking immediate action can prevent larger problems later on.
 
• **Example: **Repairing the roof before the rainy season can prevent major leaks; a stitch in time saves nine.
 
 
 
• **Every cloud has a silver lining** (हर बुराई में कुछ अच्छाई होती है):
 
 
• This idiom means that there is something positive even in difficult situations.
 
• **Example: **Although the project was canceled, it allowed us to explore new opportunities; every cloud has a silver lining.
 
 

4c:Te4f,
The correct answer is '**Option 4**'.
